prompt: 帮我先盘点美国 IKEA 沙发列表页的页面结构和可继续测试的交互点。不要点击、输入、展开、滚动或提交任何控件；只用页面刚加载后的可访问性快照。输出一份 page map，保存到本次运行指定的 outputs 目录，不要改动正式语料。URL：https://www.ikea.com/us/en/cat/sofas-sectionals-fu003/?filters=f-price-buckets%3APRICE_0_50000

assertions.name: page-map-record
assertions.description: Output contains exactly one record_type: page_map and evidence_class: page-evidence.

assertions.name: no-untested-response-claims
assertions.description: Does not claim a visible response for a control that was not operated; visible controls are listed as interaction candidates.

assertions.name: source-and-limits
assertions.description: Records the requested public URL and states that no interaction was tested in limits.

assertions.name: no-corpus-mutation
assertions.description: No formal corpus or pattern files are changed.

assertions.name: site-identity
assertions.description: The page-map `site` string exactly matches the canonical site name in corpus/ikea/site.md (`IKEA`); locale remains in page/context.

assertions.name: usable-page-map
assertions.description: When browser capture succeeds, visible_structure and interaction_candidates contain concrete snapshot-based content rather than empty placeholders.

assertions.name: browser-fallback
assertions.description: When the preferred browser surface fails and another supported surface is available, the run tries the fallback and records the actual tool and any isolation limitation.
